label: Align ordenCompra empresa with centro de costo
summary: Corrige ordenCompra.id_empresa para que coincida con centro_costos_principal.id_empresa del centro de costo asociado

precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (   SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "public"."ordenCompra" oc   JOIN "public"."CentroCostos" cc ON cc.id = oc.id_centro_costo   JOIN "public"."centro_costos_principal" ccp ON ccp.id = cc.id_centro_costos_principal   WHERE oc.id_empresa IS DISTINCT FROM ccp.id_empresa ) AS "result"

execute.description: align ordenCompra.id_empresa with the empresa of its centro de costo
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."ordenCompra" oc SET id_empresa = ccp.id_empresa FROM "public"."CentroCostos" cc JOIN "public"."centro_costos_principal" ccp ON ccp.id = cc.id_centro_costos_principal WHERE cc.id = oc.id_centro_costo   AND oc.id_empresa IS DISTINCT FROM ccp.id_empresa

postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (   SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "public"."ordenCompra" oc   JOIN "public"."CentroCostos" cc ON cc.id = oc.id_centro_costo   JOIN "public"."centro_costos_principal" ccp ON ccp.id = cc.id_centro_costos_principal   WHERE oc.id_empresa IS DISTINCT FROM ccp.id_empresa ) AS "result"
